description:
Updates a specification section revision. The request body must include `specification_section`
and `specification_section_revision` objects (see schema).

**HTTP methods:** Both `PUT` and `PATCH` are supported with the same request body.

**Success:** Returns `200 OK` with the updated revision.

**Validation errors:** Returns `422 Unprocessable Entity` when attribute validation fails
(for example duplicate number and description, invalid division or specification set, or invalid
revision). The response uses `error.code` `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, a summary `error.message`,
and `error.details` with `reason_code` `VALIDATION_ERROR` and a `failures` object whose keys are
API field names and whose values are arrays of validation message strings.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the specification section revision.

schema.description: A version of a Specification Section. Each time a Specification Section is revised, the newly uploaded version is a new revision of that section.

description.description: The description of this revision's SpecificationSection

division.description: Represents a construction division, which is used to group specification sections. Each SpecificationSectionDivision can contain many SpecificationSections.

issued_date.description: The date when the SpecificationRevision was issued by the architect

number.description: The number of this revision's SpecificationSection

received_date.description: The date when the SpecificationRevision was received by the project

revision.description: The revision number of the SpecificationSectionRevision

url.description: Address of SpecificationRevision PDF. This can be blank if the Specification Section was created manually without an upload, and no revisions have been uploaded yet.

403.description: User does not have right permissions

404.description: Not Found — the specification section revision id does not exist for this project

422.description: Unprocessable Entity — validation failed for one or more fields in the request body

schema.description: A request to edit a specification section revision.

specification_section.description: The description of the specification section

description.description: The description of the specification section

number.description: The number of the specification section

specification_section_division_id.description: The specification section division id of the specification section

obsolete.description: The obsolete status of the specification section

issued_date.description: The issued date of the specification section revision

received_date.description: The received date of the specification section revision

revision.description: The revision of the specification section revision
